title: 领益智造董事长：人形机器人2030年后爆发，中国将领先
speaker: Yvonne

segments.en: Then the Beijing one, we are focused on the China brand.
segments.zh: 北京工厂专注于中国品牌。

segments.en: So that more than 10 of the China brand is going to use the Beijing facility.
segments.zh: 超过10个中国品牌将使用北京工厂。

segments.en: We have another facility at Chengdu and another facility at Chengzhou, which is where they have three MP for human role robot.
segments.zh: 我们在成都和郑州还有工厂，人形机器人产能达300万。

segments.en: And then by this year, so far on hand, where they get more than 30,000 sets of the human role robot's PO on hand.
segments.zh: 今年至今，已收到超过3万台人形机器人订单。

segments.en: And are you looking at expanding these factories outside of China?
segments.zh: 是否考虑在中国以外扩张？

segments.en: We have a factory of the Vennang, India, Brazil, Turkey, France, and the United States and Greenland.
segments.zh: 我们在越南、印度、巴西、土耳其、法国、美国和格陵兰有工厂。

segments.en: So we are going to follow our customer reply.
What is the projected demand growth you are seeing in this human role robot sector in the US and in China? I think the really big trend would come after 20, 28, that's my guessing.
segments.zh: 你预计美国和中国人形机器人需求增长如何？我认为大趋势在2028年后。

segments.en: China is going to be really become more like, for sure, around even 2030. But we would like to do all these supporting in the beginning.
segments.zh: 中国肯定会在2030年左右成为重要市场，我们愿意早期提供支持。

segments.en: And then one day, we can really become top players in the industry.
segments.zh: 总有一天，我们会成为行业顶级玩家。
